reason: I already work hard to keep my son off the phone, and this asks me to pay ₹299 a month to put him back on it. The free report is useful and I will take it to the PTM, but I would rather the teacher work on those gaps in class.
objection: Will this actually follow his school syllabus and exam pattern, or is it generic practice? And it is more screen time, which I am trying to cut down.
would_change_my_mind: If his class teacher told me at the PTM that the app follows exactly what they teach and that his test scores went up during the pilot, with a fixed daily time limit I can set myself.
